description: This PHP class 'EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair' serves as a data transfer object (DTO) within the LDAP plugin of OrangeHRM. It encapsulates a collection of LDAP entries and their associated user lookup settings, providing getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that encapsulates a collection of LDAP entries along with user lookup settings, facilitating data exchange within the LDAP plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair with an LDAP collection and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLookupSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user lookup setting.
